tag.name: Auth
tag.description: Passkey sign-in, step-up confirmation, and accepting an invite.

post.description: Starts a discoverable-passkey sign-in (no email needed; the browser offers the passkeys it has for this app, user verification required). Returns a ceremony ID and the options to pass to `navigator.credentials.get`. The ceremony is kept for 5 minutes and can be finished once, with `POST /auth/login/finish?ceremony=…`. Send no body (the `Content-Type: application/json` header is still required).

Checks the passkey's answer against the ceremony and, if it holds, starts a session: sets the `sid` cookie (`__Host-sid` with secure cookies; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, valid 12 hours) and returns the member. A fresh sign-in counts as a step-up, so `stepped_up_until` is set. The ceremony is used up by this call whether it succeeds or not.

When Cloudflare Access is on, the passkey's account must have the same email as the Access identity. Each sign-in is checked for unusual activity (a new country or device); that check can freeze the account, in which case no session is created. Recorded in the audit log (`auth.signed_in`).

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set.

401.description: `passkey_failed`: the passkey's answer didn't verify (wrong challenge, unknown passkey, malformed body).

403.description: `access_identity_mismatch`: signed in to Cloudflare Access as someone else than the passkey's account. `account_frozen`: the account is frozen after unusual activity (already, or by this sign-in's check); an owner has been alerted and can unfreeze it.

post.description: Deletes the current session, if there is one, and clears the session cookie (`sid` / `__Host-sid`). Succeeds without a session too.

204.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared.

post.description: Starts a passkey confirmation for the signed-in member, limited to their own passkeys (user verification required). Returns a ceremony ID and the options to pass to `navigator.credentials.get`. The ceremony is tied to this session, kept for 5 minutes, and finished once with `POST /auth/stepup/finish?ceremony=…`. Send no body.

Checks the passkey's answer and marks the session as stepped up: operations with `x-step-up: true` are allowed for the next 5 minutes. Returns the member with `stepped_up_until` set. The ceremony must come from `POST /auth/stepup/begin` in the same session, and is used up by this call whether it succeeds or not.

401.description: `unauthenticated`: no valid session. `passkey_failed`: the passkey's answer didn't verify (wrong challenge, not one of the member's passkeys, malformed body).

get.description:
What the invite page shows before the new member creates a passkey: who the invite is for and when it expires. The token is the last part of the invite link.

An invite that gives admin rights (owner, approver or brand admin) may need a second admin's approval first, and one sent without approval while the company had a single admin stops working once a second admin has joined.

post.summary: Start creating a passkey for an invite
post.description: Checks the invite as `GET /invites/{token}` does, then starts a passkey registration for the invited person (a discoverable passkey, user verification required). Returns a ceremony ID and the options to pass to `navigator.credentials.create`. The ceremony is tied to this invite, kept for 5 minutes, and finished once with `POST /invites/{token}/finish?ceremony=…`. Send no body.

Checks the invite again, verifies the new passkey, and in one transaction: marks the invite used, creates the account with the invite's company role, gives it the invite's brand roles (brands deleted since are skipped), saves the passkey and starts a session. Sets the `sid` cookie (`__Host-sid` with secure cookies; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, valid 12 hours) and returns the new member, already stepped up. The ceremony is used up by this call whether it succeeds or not. Recorded in the audit log (`user.joined`).

requestBody.description: The `PublicKeyCredential` from `navigator.credentials.create`, serialized to JSON (as `PublicKeyCredential.toJSON()` gives it). Checked by the WebAuthn library, not as a plain JSON body: anything it can't verify is `passkey_failed`.

200.description: Joined and signed in; the session cookie is set.

400.description: `ceremony_expired`: no such ceremony for this invite (expired, already used, or from another flow); start again with `/begin`. `passkey_failed`: the passkey couldn't be created or didn't verify.

409.description: `invite_needs_approval`: an admin-rights invite sent before a second admin joined; an owner has to send a new one. `invite_awaiting_approval`: a second admin hasn't approved it yet. `invite_used`: it was accepted meanwhile. `already_member`: the email already has an account.

ceremony.description: Pass back as `?ceremony=` to the matching `/finish`.

options.description: WebAuthn request options for `navigator.credentials.get` (binary fields base64url-encoded).
WebAuthn creation options for `navigator.credentials.create` (binary fields base64url-encoded).

publicKey.description: `PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions`: rp, user, challenge, pubKeyCredParams, authenticatorSelection, excludeCredentials.

response.description: The authenticator's response (assertion or attestation), fields base64url-encoded.

AuthInviteToken.name: token
AuthInviteToken.description: The token from the invite link (`/invite/{token}`). Only its hash is stored.

AuthAssertion.description: The `PublicKeyCredential` from `navigator.credentials.get`, serialized to JSON (as `PublicKeyCredential.toJSON()` gives it). Checked by the WebAuthn library, not as a plain JSON body: anything it can't verify is `passkey_failed`.

AuthSessionCookie.description: The new session: `sid=…` (`__Host-sid` with secure cookies), HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age 12 hours.

AuthCeremonyExpired.description: `ceremony_expired`: no such ceremony for this flow (expired after 5 minutes, already used, or started by another flow or session); start again with `/begin`.

AuthInviteInvalid.description: `invite_invalid`: the link is invalid, used or expired, or its approval was rejected, cancelled or expired.

AuthInviteMismatch.description: `access_identity_mismatch`: the invite is for another email than the Cloudflare Access identity (only when Access is on).

AuthInviteBlocked.description: `invite_needs_approval`: an admin-rights invite sent before a second admin joined; an owner has to send a new one (it will need approval). `invite_awaiting_approval`: an admin-rights invite a second admin hasn't approved yet.
